owner_id.description: AstrBot sender_id allowed to use DeskWarden. It must exactly match the owner message sender_id.
owner_id.hint: When empty, every /desk command is refused.

daemon_url.description: DeskWarden local daemon URL. It must be an HTTP loopback URL.
daemon_url.hint: The default daemon listens on http://127.0.0.1:8765.

data_dir.description: Plugin directory for storing the local shared secret.
data_dir.hint: Do not sync this directory to a public repository.

rpc_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for local daemon RPC calls.
rpc_timeout_seconds.hint: Loopback requests should normally use a short timeout.

agent_enabled.description: Enable the natural-language DeskWarden agent entrypoint.
agent_enabled.hint: When enabled, /desk chat can run guarded LLM desktop tasks.

agent_auto_capture_private_messages.description: Allow agent mode to capture non-command owner private messages.
agent_auto_capture_private_messages.hint: Keep disabled unless you want ordinary owner private messages to be treated as desktop tasks while /desk agent on is active.

max_agent_steps.description: Maximum tool steps per /desk chat run.
max_agent_steps.hint: Prevents runaway desktop loops. Values are clamped to 1 through 30.

llm_vision_enabled.description: Pass screenshot references to compatible AstrBot model providers.
llm_vision_enabled.hint: If the current model provider does not support images, DeskWarden falls back to text-only observations.

approval_for_all_mutations.description: Require approval for all agent-initiated desktop and browser interactions.
approval_for_all_mutations.hint: The default uses DeskWarden's normal risk classifier; enable for a stricter agent mode.

agent_summary_limit.description: Maximum characters of observation and tool result context sent to the agent.
